decisions.reason: The app builds directly on the firm's existing practice management and regulatory knowledge, enabling it to interpret feedback and improve the product.
The education institute leverages the firm's established training content and customer relationships, so it can be assimilated into the existing business.
The remote support tool is closely related to the firm's software support and engineering capabilities, making it easy to learn from and enhance.
The analytics dashboard builds on the firm's existing data and software expertise, allowing it to apply insights from practice management data.
The complete bundle is a repackaging of the firm's established offerings, so it requires no new knowledge and can be improved continuously.
The job and practice listing portal is distant from the firm's core software and support knowledge, limiting its ability to recognize and act on market feedback.
